primitives.name: Odds Ingestion Pipeline
primitives.verbatim_quote: Odds Ingestion Pipeline & Worker Synchronization Synchronize `packages/ingestion-pipeline` and `workers/data-refresh` with the Galaxy keyless-first path, ensuring clean fallbacks to paid feeds (opt-in via `ODDS_PROVIDER`), proper provider tagging, zero schema drift, and write-once bet term preservation.

primitives.breakdown_regime: When schema drift exceeds threshold S > 0, pipeline halts until resolution.

primitives.name: Test Suite Isolation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Test Suite Isolation & Clean Verification Ensure Vitest and build configurations ignore detached worktrees (`.worktrees/**`) so tests run strictly scoped to the repository, with 100% of pipeline tests passing without mock leaks or type errors.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'W': 'worktree identifier', 'M': 'mock leak indicator', 'T': 'test suite execution time'}
primitives.assumptions: Detached worktrees are excluded from test scope; full test suite must pass.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If M > 0, test suite fails due to mock contamination.

layer2.mapping: Isolation kernel ensures orthogonal test execution paths, preventing cross-contamination between modules.
layer2.telemetry: 100% pass rate on pipeline tests with no mock leaks.

primitives.name: Cloud Backend Integration
primitives.verbatim_quote: Cloud Backend & Optimizer Integration Ensure the newly wired Neon S3-compatible storage and AI Gateway services in `.env.local` connect reliably with downstream snapshot exporters, and ensure optimizer tooling in `intelligence/optimizer/` (`dfs_optimizer_suite.py` and `pull_entries.py`) is verified against ingested research data.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S': 'storage service (Neon S3)', 'A': 'AI gateway interface', 'D': 'data flow direction', 'R': 'research data set'}
primitives.assumptions: Storage and AI gateway are configured correctly; optimizer tools are validated against real data.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If D ≠ R, data integrity is compromised.

layer2.mapping: Backend integration maps to GSE's state transition model where data flows from ingest → storage → optimizer → export.
layer2.telemetry: All downstream snapshot exports match ingested research data.
